title: National Conservation and Environment Protection Act (Cap. 11.03)
evidence: Page 1 of the official consolidated text (Revised Edition as at 31 December 2009, prepared under the Law Revision Act, Cap. 1.03): "Act 5 of 1987 … in force 3rd July 1989". Opened https://lawcommission.gov.kn/wp-content/documents/Act02and09TOC/Ch-11_03-National-Conservation-and-Environment-Protection-Act.pdf on 2026-11-05.
notes: Official consolidation of Cap. 11.03 as at 31 December 2009. Incorporates amendments by Act 12 of 1996 and Act 21 of 2001, and subsidiary legislation S.R.O. 11/1991 and S.R.O. 6/2004 (Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer (Control) Regulations). Status is link only because publisher source row KN-LAWCOMMISSION-CONSOLIDATED verdict is permission requested under site Terms of Use and Copyright Act 2024 has no statute exception for official texts.

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2023 (Act No. 21 of 2023)
evidence: Part I Section 1(2): "Subject to subsection (3), this Act shall come into force on a date to be fixed, by the Minister, by Order published in the Gazette." Gazette publication on 14 December 2023 (Official Gazette No. 73 of 2023); no appointed day order found in official publications up to 2026-11-05.
notes: Replaced the older Consumer Affairs Act and established the Consumer Protection Board. Prohibits misleading and deceptive conduct in trade or commerce as an umbrella for environmental and sustainability claims.
